title: Travel Evidence
description: Evidence rules for travel and country reasoning.

entries.title: Literal Travel Evidence
entries.description: The exact text says or shows travel, places, or movement.

entries.title: Contextual Travel Evidence
entries.description: Neighbouring context clarifies the travel meaning.

entries.title: Dialogue Evidence
entries.description: A character directly speaks about travel or a country.

entries.title: Narration Evidence
entries.description: Narration describes travel or country details.

entries.title: Scene Evidence
entries.description: Scene details show the travel or country context.

entries.title: Historical Evidence
entries.description: Historical framing supports migration or travel history.

entries.title: Fiction Evidence
entries.description: Fiction or dream framing changes interpretation.

entries.title: Quoted Evidence
entries.description: The text is quoted and may not reflect endorsement.

entries.title: Evaluative Evidence
entries.description: The text evaluates a country, people, or place.

entries.title: Comparison Evidence
entries.description: The text compares countries, cultures, or places.

entries.title: Travel Document Evidence
entries.description: Passport or visa language supports travel interpretation.

entries.title: Border Evidence
entries.description: Border crossing, customs, or entry details are present.

entries.title: Migration Evidence
entries.description: Movement into or out of a country is explicit.
